intent: Compare the vegan population share against the whole US population in 2008 and report the share attributable to vegans.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Report the share of the whole US population attributable to vegans in 2008.

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in single composition.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: The vegan population share of the whole US population in 2008 is 0.5%.

optional_valid: Labeling the gauge as the vegan population share of the US in 2008.
unsupported_to_avoid: Reporting an absolute vegan population count not present in the table.
Comparing against other years or countries not present in the table.
Deriving a non-vegan remainder as a separate required unit.
review_notes: The table provides only the vegan share; the whole is the US population in 2008. The partial ring/gauge directly encodes this share.
relative_value 0.005 corresponds to 0.5%, matching the label.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
